questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne til et varmt engelsktalende land, som var varmt og velfungerende

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Sydney og Australien er fuldstændig fantastisk, men de har en boligkrise lige nu, så husk at søg en masse legater og vær indstillet på at dele et værelse med anden, hvis du skal afsted

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: The University of Sydney er ekstremt gode til at give tonsvis af informationer om alt, og de har en meget velfungerende studieadministration. Det er dog vigtigt, at du skriver dig op til Queen Marys Building, hvis du gerne vil have et nogenlunde betaleligt kollegie at bo tæt på uni. Vær dog opmærksom på, at man skal være meget hurtigt ude for at sikre sig en plads.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der er velkomstdage, introdage, velkomstfest og en masse sociale arrangementer i den første uge. Vil virkelig anbefale dig at deltage i det, da det var her, hvor jeg fandt de fleste af de venner, som jeg havde gennem semesteret :-)

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Du er garanteret et sted at bo gennem The University of Sydney. Vær dog opmærksom på, at hvis du ikke skriver dig op til Queen Marys Building risikerer du at måtte betale 7.500 - 15.000 /måneden for et sted at bo

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Scape Sydney Central kan anbefales, hvis du ikke når at få en plads på Queen Marys Building.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man har mulighed for at skifte fag i løbet af de første to uger og man kan ofte selv vælge, hvilket tidspunkt man gerne vil have sin holdundervisning, hvilket giver mulighed for et fleksibelt skema og mulighed for at rejse i løbet af semesteret.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Yes, deres studeadministration er fuldstændig fantastisk, og de har et såkaldt "Student Help Center" på biblioteket, hvor du kan få hjælp med det hele af venlige sjæle.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Fik alle dem, som jeg ønskede mig. De valgte dog at droppe et fag om kinesisk politik, som jeg var tilmeldt uden at oplyse mig om det, så det var lidt stressende, da jeg meget hurtigt så skulle finde et nyt fag.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Husk at du kan skifte fag efter at have været til den første forelæsning og holdundervisning - man er ikke bundet på samme måde som på KU.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
Niveauet var egentlig fint nok, men undervisningen (i hvert fald på statskundskab) var meget politisk og ikke særlig forskningsbaseret. Det var lidt mere ligesom at gå i gymnasiet, hvor man bare snakkede om spændende ting uden at forholde sig så meget til forskningen eller gik ordentlig i dybden med noget. 

Og undervisningen baserer sig nærmest ikke på pensum, så det føltes lidt som spild af tid at forberede sig inden undervisningen.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer:
Mindre krævende, mere holdningsbaseret, meget venstreorienteret.

Til gengæld var alle underviserne meget passionerede om deres fag og ønskede virkelig, at vi studerende bidrog med vores inputs.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
1.Rethinking Poverty
2. Forces of Changes in Int Relations
3. Public Opinion, Policy and Public Sphere
4. Key Issues in Peace and Conflict Studies

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Fantastisk underviser i det antropologiske fag "Rethinking Poverty"

Underviseren i fredsfaget var ret irriterende og selvsmagende

Hvis du har haft et fag om International Politik er Forces of Changes in Int Relations meget nemt og overfladisk.

Housing DKK per month *

Personal spending DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ikke rigtig nogle overraskelser, men øl i supermarkederne er dyrere end i København

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer:
Kaffe på caféer er cirka halv pris af København. 

Du kan desuden få 4 liter papvin til 42 kr, og så skal du prøve et genialt frozen yoghurt sted ved navn Yo-Chi.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er over 200 forskellige klubber på University of Sydney, så uanset hvad du interesserer dig for, kan du finde nogle at dele din interesse med :-)

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Sportsklubber, hobbyklubber, religiøse foreninger. Altså der var ALLE slags foreninger!

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hike-klubben på uni er en fantastisk måde at komme ud at opleve en masse af Australiens smukke natur meget billigt

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag til Whitsundays - det er de lækreste bountystrande, som jeg nogensinde har været på. Når du er der bør du desuden købe en tur, hvor du overnatter på et sejlskib.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Australiere minder meget om danskere, men er lidt mere åbne og amerikanske i deres møde med fremmede.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Det er svært. Regn med at komme ind i en boble med andre exchange-students. Og så undgå kun at være sammen med andre danskere - det er trods alt sjovere at møde nye mennesker fra hele verden.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: De har en forholdsvis striks alkohol-lovgivning, så du kommer ikke ind på klubben, hvis du er tydeligt beruset.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Klimaet, naturen og alle de fantastiske mennesker fra hele verden, som jeg mødte.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Det er dyrt. Så husk at søge masser af legater og skriv dig op til kollegiet Queen Marys Building.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hvis du er i tvivl om du skal tage af sted, så gør det. Men forvent at sparegrisen er tom, når du kommer hjem igen.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle de nye venskaber og bekendtskaber, som jeg fik. Nu har jeg et netværk i hele verden, så jeg altid har en lokal at besøge, når jeg er ude at rejse.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Savnede min kæreste og mine venner

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
